goal: Identify the highest-potential net-new mobile app ideas to launch as an AI-first startup. Each idea must be CRITICALLY dependent on AI capabilities that became feasible only very recently (agentic multi-step workflows, on-device multimodal models, real-time voice, long-context reasoning, cheap inference). HARD GATE: reject any idea that could have been built a year ago without these new capabilities. Ideas should ride emerging automation trends where users will pay to save time and/or money, targeting consumers AND small-business/prosumer users. Scope spans all ~52 consumer/prosumer software categories in the provided category map. Score each idea on estimated addressable subscriber base, competitor landscape (white space), and a credible path to $1-5M+/yr revenue (~1% conversion of a defined base, via subscription or one-time sales) -- revenue headroom is a heavily-weighted scoring dimension, not a hard filter.
feedback:
RECURRING_ISSUES:
- Soft recency that doesn't bind: hypotheses anchored on "1M+ context" or "hour-long video" â€” both shipped Feb 2024 (Gemini 1.5). The single most common failure (h016/h018/h020). Context SIZE is not a 2025/2026 lock; only REASONING QUALITY AT LENGTH (multi-needle recall, cross-reference, contradiction-finding over the full window) is.
- Crowding invisible until deep search: losers were killed by vertical-AI startups already shipping the exact mechanic (Clinplex/Leaf/Assyro for h019; Hercules/Ecliptic/Send for h018; Nomad/Kolena/V7/Five Sigma for h016/h020; BillGuard for h014). Surface-level "no incumbent" did not survive an exhaustive named sweep.
- Catastrophic-single-miss recall risk: domains where one missed needle is a disaster (biotech eCTD h019 ~60% recall past 400-500k; insurance numeric h016 60-90% accuracy) score poorly â€” current long-context recall can't clear the buyer's error bar.
- TAM inflation: even co-leader h013 took a hit for ~10x-inflated TAM. Bottom-up math is being skipped.
- Slow sales cycle on the high-WTP buyers: best white space (studios h013, universities/grants h017) sits behind 6-18mo procurement, undercutting near-term revenue credibility.

WHAT_WINS:
- Defensible white space that survives a named-competitor sweep (h013, h017).
- A buyer with an EXPENSIVE AND URGENT failure mode â€” a burning platform (HHS-OIG/AERO for h017) beats nice-to-have.
- A recency lock grounded in reasoning-at-length quality, not raw context size.
- Tolerant recall profile: domains where a missed item is recoverable/additive (human triage), not a single catastrophic miss.

GUIDANCE_NEXT_ROUND (FINAL):
1. Bind recency to a 2025-2026 reasoning-at-length capability, stated explicitly: name WHICH post-mid-2025 capability makes it newly possible (reliable multi-document contradiction-detection across a full window; agentic multi-hop cross-referencing; sustained reasoning quality at 200k-1M tokens â€” the thing Gemini 1.5's SIZE did not deliver Feb 2024). Reject any hypothesis whose only novelty is context-window size, "reads long video," or "ingests big PDFs."
2. Run an explicit named-incumbent kill-test in the output: list 3-5 specific vertical-AI startups/products in the exact niche + why each does NOT ship the mechanic. Can't name them or gap is thin -> drop it.
3. Prefer tolerant-recall, fast-cycle segments: favor additive/triage output (surfaces candidates a human confirms) over exhaustive single-pass recall with catastrophic single-miss cost. Pair with a buyer who buys fast (PLG, dept budget, <90-day cycle) over enterprise/gov procurement.
4. Show bottom-up addressable-base math: # buyers x realistic ACV x 1% conversion = revenue; tie the $1-5M path to that arithmetic. Penalize unsupported TAM.
5. Optimize final slate for revenue x defensibility jointly. Evolve the co-leaders toward weaknesses: h013 -> faster-cycle adjacent buyer / land-and-expand; h017 -> binding reasoning-at-length lock + faster procurement entry. Generate 1-2 NEW hypotheses that combine winning traits (defensible white space + urgent expensive failure + binding reasoning-at-length lock + tolerant recall + fast buyer) rather than re-exploring rejected soft-recency space.
